main.description: The permissioned-space type for a publication's newsletter subscriber list (AT Protocol Proposal 0016). One space per publication, keyed by the publication rkey. `collections` enumerates the record types members may write into the space; a HappyView instance that can resolve this lexicon uses it to populate the space's `allowedCollections`. NOTE: `space` is an experimental Proposal-0016 def type, not a standard atproto lexicon primitive.
